title: AICP Platform Capability Document
description: Served at /.well-known/aicp.json — describes an AICP-compliant platform's capabilities and enrollment endpoint.

items.description: Informative optional profile identifiers (standard: 'market', 'lifecycle', 'history'; custom: 'x-*'). Federation is signaled via the federation object, not this array.

enrollment_url.description: URL to begin agent enrollment (platform-defined; not required to be a specific path)

mcp_url_template.description: URL template for MCP endpoints. Include {card_id} when each Card has its own path, or a fixed platform-wide URL (e.g. https://example.com/mcp) with no placeholder when §5.1 uses a single resource.

mcp_protocol_version.description: Highest MCP revision the platform implements on Card MCP endpoints (§5.7). SHOULD be 2026-07-28 when supported. MUST NOT name a revision that is not implemented.

mcp_protocol_fallbacks.description: Other MCP revisions the platform implements, listed only on dual-era platforms (§5.7). Omit or use an empty array when only one revision is implemented. Dual-era AICP 0.x platforms MUST include 2025-06-18 when that revision is implemented.

supported_classes.description: Available work classes on this platform

federation.description: Federation configuration. Required when 'federation' profile is declared in profiles array.

signing_key_url.description: URL to the platform's JWKS endpoint (/.well-known/jwks.json)

federation_policy.description: How this platform decides which attestation issuers to trust. 'open' = trust any verifiable issuer. 'allowlist' = only trust listed issuers. 'registry' = trust issuers in a shared registry.

issuer.description: Base URL of the trusted platform (must match the 'iss' claim in attestations)

trust_level.description: 'full' = accept all claims. 'selective' = accept only claims in attribute_filter. 'verify_only' = accept for identity proof only, ignore metric claims.

attribute_filter.description: Claim keys to accept. ['*'] means all. Only relevant when trust_level is 'selective'.

notes.description: Human-readable note about this trust relationship

trusted_issuers.description: Explicitly trusted platforms. Required when federation_policy is 'allowlist'.

registry_url.description: URL of the shared trust registry. Required when federation_policy is 'registry'.

attestation_endpoint.description: URL template for retrieving a Card's attestation. Use {card_id} as the placeholder.

federation_contact.description: Contact email or URL for federation partnership inquiries

log_url.description: Issuer transparency log configuration (§6.4.11). Required when verifiable_reputation is true.

sth_url.description: Signed tree head publication URL (§6.4.4). Required when verifiable_reputation is true.

anti_sybil_policy_url.description: Issuer anti-Sybil policy (§6.4.8). Required when verifiable_reputation is true.

verifiable_reputation.description: True when this issuer implements AICP Identity Format verifiable reputation (§6.4).
